from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PAGE = ROOT / 'frontend/src/pages/Finanzas.js'
UI = ROOT / 'frontend/src/components/finanzas/FinanzasDecisionPago.jsx'
ROUTER = ROOT / 'backend/modules/finanzas/cuentas_por_pagar.py'

def read(path):
    return path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')

def test_decision_pago_does_not_load_full_cxp_from_page():
    page = read(PAGE)
    assert "activeTab === 'cxp' || activeTab === 'decision-pago'" not in page
    assert "if (activeTab === 'cxp')" in page

def test_decision_dashboard_refresh_is_local():
    ui = read(UI)
    assert 'decisionRefreshKey' in ui
    assert 'setDecisionRefreshKey' in ui
    assert 'decisionResumen.saldo_cxp' in ui
    assert 'decisionResumen.comprometido' in ui
    assert 'decisionResumen.autorizado' in ui

def test_cxp_full_list_propagates_current_user():
    router = read(ROUTER)
    assert 'unidades_permitidas=None, current_user=None):' in router
    assert '_cxp_factura_dict(r, current_user)' in router
    start = router.index('async def listar_facturas_pendientes')
    end = router.index('@router.get("/resumen")', start)
    block = router[start:end]
    assert '_cxp_listar_canonico(' in block
    assert 'current_user,' in block
